Welcome to Perdehoek

A farm made for long, unhurried celebrations

Perdehoek is a working horse farm where your wedding has room to breathe. Say your vows in the garden, dine at long timber tables under glowing chandeliers, and fall asleep a few steps from your guests.

Down-to-earth, family-run and warm, with horses in the fields and sundowners at the braai.

Plan your day

The hall

Rafters, chandeliers and one very long table

The function hall seats up to 150 guests beneath exposed timber trusses, fairy lights and chandeliers. It also works for functions, parties and conferences.

  • Breakfast can be served to large groups in the hall
  • The hall can sleep up to 20 guests if needed
  • Safe parking, with ample space for trailers
The gardens

Lawns, pergolas and shade for everyone

Draped timber pergolas, a white garden arch, lounge corners under the trees and a pond with water lilies give you plenty of places to marry, mingle and take photographs.

  • Open lawns with room for the whole guest list
  • Braai area for sundowners and a small splash pool
  • Fire pit beneath the weeping willow

Stay

Sleep on the farm, together

Simple, down-to-earth rooms in garden cottages, from R550 a night for two. Linen and towels are provided, and every unit has its own bathroom.
